note: Small rustic provincial recreation area ~30 km S of Swan Hills on Hwy 33 at the historic Trapper Lea's cabin site, leased to the Town of Swan Hills; sites suit RVs and tents. Cook, picnic and warm-up shelters and a loading ramp; the hand pump is not drinking water. The agency says registered campers can reach the nearby OHV trails from their campsites. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (May 7, 2026) + Town of Swan Hills page: C$20 FCFS confirmed; sites 20 (derived) -> 18; season May 15 - Sep 15; vault toilets, non-potable pump; phone 780-333-4477; OHV access from campsites = drop candidate; pin OK.
flags: CRITERIA / OHV (drop candidate): the agency's own page says 'There are OHV trails nearby, which registered campers can access from their campsites.' and lists a 'Loading Ramp'. Riding from the campsite to the trails is OHV use in the campground, the same pattern as Waiparous/Fallen Timber South ('travel to OHV trails from their campsites'). The Town of Swan Hills camping page does not mention OHVs for this site.

PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 780-333-4477' (= Town of Swan Hills office, PH 780-333-4477 on the town site). Page names 'Leaseholder: Town of Swan Hills'; the town's 2024 camping page instead says 'Managed by Blue Ridge Lumber, Operated by Top Height Forestry.' No Facility Operator line. NO seniors line on this page.

POLICY ROW: first-come only, so the provincial:AB shop/window/fee keys do not arise (not inherited here). Leased to the town; fees are posted on the Alberta Parks page, so no policy_ref change is needed unless the reviewer wants one for the leasehold.

WEBSITE: stored = the park root (https://www.albertaparks.ca/parks/central/trapper-lea-s-cabin-pra/). PIN (54.52327,-115.09393): on imagery it is the grass clearing at the entrance off Hwy 33; the campground lane runs ~150 m NE into the trees from it; the page's directions point is 54.523275,-115.093272 (~45 m). OK.
